external_collaboration.evidence_quote: If you would like to be considered as a potential bidder, please register with Building Connected.

Per Senate Bill 854, all subcontractors who wish to bid on public works projects must be registered with the Department of Industrial Relations (DIR). For more information, or to apply for contractor registration, please visit the DIR website.

If awarded, all subcontractors and suppliers agree to utilize Procore for project management and document transfer. Docusign (via Procore) will be utilized for signatures on all issued contracts and change orders. Login information will be provided by Roebbelen at time of award. See www.procore.com for more details.
